Headline

The US-Iran War enters its 103rd day with a tactical ceasefire holding but a diplomatic deal demonstrably more distant than Trump's repeated "final throes" framing implies. Three signals dominate this morning: first, Trump warned Netanyahu directlykeralakaumudi.com against new strikes while a US Army AH-64 Apache went down near the Strait of Hormuznbcdfw.com, exposing the hairline gap between declared victory and operational reality; second, Xi Jinping completed a two-day Pyongyang summitbbc.com with Kim Jong Un, his first North Korea visit since 2019, vowing stronger ties in a move that functions simultaneously as strategic signaling to Washington and reassertion of leverage over Pyongyang; and third, CISA added a command-injection vulnerability in BerriAI LiteLLM to the Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog, the first KEV entry targeting a commercially deployed LLM orchestration framework. Watch areas Israel-Iran-Hezbollah axis (47 items, 47% above 14-day median) and Ukraine frontline (38 items, 27% above 14-day median) both fired.

Macro Situation

![2026-06-17-yield_curve.png]

Easing

The yield curve as of June 5 shows no inversion: the 10Y-2Y spread stands at +41 basis pointsfred.stlouisfed.org, recovered from the near-zero and inverted readings of late 2024. The front end (1-month) sits at 3.65% while the 30-year clears 5.01%fred.stlouisfed.org and the 10-year is at 4.55%fred.stlouisfed.org. This normalization reflects the Fed easing cycle: the effective Fed Funds rate of 3.62%fred.stlouisfed.org represents roughly 200bp of cuts from the 2024-25 peak. One year ago the 2-5 year segment was inverted; today the inversion is fully resolved. The structural question is whether the steepening reflects a genuine soft-landing or is driven by a rising term premium on long-duration debt, given fiscal pressure and the war environment. The 30Y at 5.01% argues for term premium as the driver, not pure growth optimism [medium].

![2026-06-17-anomaly_screen.png]

Anomaly

Three indicators are printing above 2-sigma against the 90-day baseline: WTI crude at +2.4 sigma ($95.96, FRED DCOILWTICOfred.stlouisfed.org), JPY/USD at +2.8 sigma (160.26, FRED DEXJPUSfred.stlouisfed.org), and Bitcoin at +2.1 sigma (+4.87% on the week). The JPY anomaly is structurally significant: a 160 handle for dollar-yen historically signals that the Bank of Japan is either unwilling or unable to defend the exchange rate, a condition that preceded disorderly yen moves in 1998 and 2022. The difference today is that the BOJ is not under speculative attack; the yen is being driven by the JPY-USD carry trade reinflating under the divergence between Fed's 3.62% policy rate and BOJ's near-zero rate. If carry-trade positioning gets squeezed by a risk-off shock, the unwind could be rapid [medium].

The Fed balance sheet at $6.71Tfred.stlouisfed.org remains elevated under QT, constrained by the fiscal cost of running QT at scale when long-end yields are at 5%.

United States Politics and Policy

The Federal Register for June 9federalregister.gov carried 17 new regulatory items. The State Department's temporary final rule creating a $750 expedited B1/B2 visa appointment feefederalregister.gov compounds the access-restriction pattern already affecting World Cup visitors. The Copyright Office opened its tenth triennial DMCA rulemakingfederalregister.gov under Section 1201, inviting comment on access-control circumvention exemptions: a recurring signal for tech/security policy. The most legally significant domestic action this cycle is Judge Leo Sorokin's ruling in the District of Massachusetts striking down the $100,000 H-1B supplemental feewkms.org as unlawful. The fee would have priced out most mid-size technology employers from using skilled foreign labor. The ruling is a federal bench check on executive immigration-fee authority; a First Circuit appeal is near-certain. Combined with Iran's football fans having their World Cup ticket allocation revoked and the Somali referee denied US entrybbc.com, the US is accumulating documented entry-denial patterns that FIFA's disciplinary review will assess against host-nation obligations.

The HHS rescission of the Obama-era noncustodial parent employment training rulefederalregister.gov removes Title IV-D funding authority for child-support agencies to fund job training for parents behind on payments. The CFTC rescinded its settlements policyfederalregister.gov, removing the limitation that prevented respondents from contesting facts while agreeing to penalties: a shift toward more adversarial CFTC enforcement posture. Sam Bankman-Fried is seeking a Trump pardonbbc.com from FCI Cumberland, where he is serving a 25-year sentence; the pardon trajectory is a function of SBF's ability to provide political value the administration finds useful [low].

The Gordie Howe International Bridgebbc.com between Windsor and Detroit nears opening despite earlier Trump threats to block it, a positive bilateral trade-infrastructure signal after months of tariff friction with Canada. The H-1B fee ruling in Boston is the most significant immigration court action of the cycle; the First Circuit is the next procedural step.

South America

Peru's presidential race resolved in favor of Keiko Fujimori with Polymarket pricing her win at 94%polymarket.com, Roberto Sánchez Palomino at 5%. Fujimori returns backed by the Fuerza Popular congressional bloc after two failed prior runs. Her administration inherits a commodity-dependent economy under copper-price volatility and anti-mining social pressure in the highlands. The US-China competition for South American lithium and copper supply chains is the strategic context: Fujimori's investment-permissive posture is more favorable to US and Australian mining capital than her opponent's platform was.

Tyler Cowen's São Paulo notesmarginalrevolution.com describe a Brazil paradox: the "country of the future" critique "now seems so wrong," with a conservative, aging, low-birth-rate society emerging. Cowen's observation that domestic airport couples have one child, not two or three, points to a demographic-dividend reversal that growth models for Brazil's 2030-40 trajectory have not fully absorbed [medium].

Europe

The EU's 21st Russia sanctions package focuses on shadow-fleet maritime enforcement and asset-seizure provisions. The critical test is whether Rotterdam and Antwerp enforce shadow-fleet clauses at a detention level that meaningfully raises Urals crude shipping costs. The pattern of 20 prior packages with limited maritime enforcement suggests institutional reluctance [medium]. If Ireland wins an Aughinish Alumina carve-out from the new package, it establishes a template for other member states with Russian-linked industrial assets to negotiate out of enforcement.

Spain reported record April tourist arrivals at 9.1 millionbbc.com, benefiting from Middle East travel avoidance. The ICC's suspension of Chief Prosecutor Karim Khanbbc.com is the week's European institutional story: Khan is the first sitting ICC prosecutor to be suspended. The timing, during active Gaza and Ukraine investigation caseloads, creates a leadership vacuum that benefits states under ICC scrutiny. Khan's lawyers say he "rejects the decision in the strongest terms."

The EU-Iran commercial relationship faces pressure from the US blockade regime; EUR/USD at 1.1533 reflects euro strength partly driven by dollar weakness during the war period. A peace deal closing would likely bring partial dollar recovery that compresses the EUR/USD back toward 1.09-1.11 [medium].

The FIRMS thermal data from June 15 recorded 156 anomalies across Ukraine and adjacent Russian territory. The dominant cluster at approximately (47N, 32E) totaled 794.8 MW FRP across 34 anomalies in the Kherson/Mykolaiv oblast zone. This is the most intense thermal signature in the dataset by a wide margin; it is consistent with large-scale fire activity along the contested left-bank Dnipro agricultural corridor, though optical imagery cross-check would be needed to distinguish conflict-driven from agricultural fires. Secondary clusters: (47N, 33E) at 116.1 MW (Zaporizhzhia western margin); (46N, 32E) at 72.4 MW (lower Dnipro sector); (48N, 33-35E) at 39.7 and 30.6 MW (Dnipropetrovsk industrial bend); (52N, 34E) at 36.8 MW (Sumy/Chernihiv near Russian Bryansk/Kursk border).

Ukrainian drones struck all four Chongar bridgesliveuamap.com in the occupied Kherson/Crimea junction, the land route connecting occupied Kherson territory to Crimea north of the isthmus. The Chongar crossing is one of three routes to Crimea alongside the Kerch bridge and Arabat spit road; disrupting all four bridge structures simultaneously, even temporarily, forces Russian resupply onto the Kerch route and extends transit times for southern-axis logistics.

Zelensky's confirmed casualty figuresliveuamap.com: approximately 45,100 Ukrainians killed and 390,000 injured since February 2022. These are official Ukrainian figures; independent analysts place total military casualties (killed plus wounded) on both sides above 500,000. These figures predate the June 17 reporting period.

Cyber and Biosecurity

FIRST-OF-KIND KEV CALLOUT: CISA's addition of CVE-2026-42271nvd.nist.gov targeting BerriAI LiteLLM to the Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on June 8 is the first KEV entry for a commercially deployed LLM orchestration and routing framework. LiteLLM is widely used in enterprise AI deployments to proxy and route calls across multiple LLM providers; a command-injection vulnerability in this middleware layer allows an attacker with network access to execute arbitrary commands on the host running the LLM routing service. The structural signal: adversaries have now weaponized a vulnerability at the AI middleware tier, not the model itself, not the application above it, but the infrastructure between them. This is the first time CISA has catalogued a CVE at the LLM orchestration layer of the AI stack.

Alongside LiteLLM, Check Point Security Gateway (CVE-2026-50751nvd.nist.gov) was added with a CISA remediation deadline of June 11 (already past), an improper-authentication vulnerability in a product deployed at enterprise perimeters. The 72-hour remediation window suggests active exploitation was already in progress. Earlier in the 14-day KEV window: SolarWinds Serv-Unvd.nist.gov (remediate by June 19), Nx Consolenvd.nist.gov and TanStacknvd.nist.gov (both RANSOMWARE-LINKED embedded malicious code, developer-tool supply chain), and Palo Alto PAN-OS auth bypassnvd.nist.gov.

The ProMED feed has been inactive for 20+ consecutive pull attempts (404 error since early June). An 18% CFR suggests either a more tractable strain or unusually strong early treatment access compared to historical EVD outbreaks in the DRC [medium].

Environment, Disasters, and Climate

The Philippines earthquake sequence is the primary geophysical event this cycle. USGS data shows 21 new M4.5+ events in the June 8-9 window. The Mindanao cluster near Balangonan/Lumatil includes two M5.3-5.5 events at 35-82km depth consistent with subduction-zone mechanics. A Cuba M6.1 at 104km WNW of Mantua (26km depth) is a shallow-to-moderate event with proximity to older building stock; casualty figures are not yet in the data.

The GDELT tone heatmap for June 9 shows the Middle East at -8.4, the most negative regional reading in the dataset, a sharp deterioration from -5.1 two weeks prior. This corresponds to the resumption of Israeli strikes in Lebanon and the Strait of Hormuz Apache incident. Russia/Eastern Europe at -3.8 (from -2.9) reflects the sustained war environment. Over the past month the dominant arc moved from the Iran war's active phase through a ceasefire, the SpaceX IPO at unprecedented valuation, Peru's presidential resolution to Fujimori, and the Philippines earthquake sequence. All four were absent or low-probability 90 days ago. The macro delta from 90 days prior: WTI +$28/barrel (war premium), yield curve uninverted, VIX from approximately 14 to 21.51, EUR/USD from approximately 1.09 to 1.1533.

Easing

Over the past year the most significant FRED structural shifts are: unemployment rising from 3.7% to 4.3%; Fed Funds falling from approximately 5.5% to 3.62% (full easing cycle); 30Y moving from below 5% to 5.01%; EUR/USD rising from approximately 1.07 to 1.1533. The directional pattern is consistent with a soft-landing scenario where the Fed cut ahead of the slowdown, the dollar weakened, and EM benefited. The war premium in oil is the primary counterfactual variable: without the Iran conflict, WTI would likely be in the $65-75 range, headline CPI closer to target, and the Fed would have cut further [medium].

What to Watch: Next 14 Days

The Iran diplomatic calendar is the highest-stakes near-term event. The June 15 Oman-track deadline missed; the next formal window is unclear. Pakistani mediation and the 68% Polymarket December 31 probability suggest markets are pricing a Q3 close. The first US-Iran direct-channel signal (formal meeting, joint statement, or treaty text) would be an immediate market event: WTI decline of $15-20/barrel, dollar recovery, VIX compression. Watch for any White House contact with Iranian counterparts via the Pakistani or Omani channels.

The Fed's June FOMC meeting (within the 14-day window; calendarfederalreserve.gov) is the next major monetary policy signal. With DFF at 3.62% and unemployment at 4.3%, the probability of another 25bp cut is elevated, but WTI at $95.96 keeps headline CPI above target. A cut signals the Fed is prioritizing labor market stability over oil-driven inflation residuals, a modestly dollar-negative, equity-positive read.

CISA KEV remediation deadlines within the window: Check Point Security Gateway June 11 (already past), SolarWinds Serv-U June 19, LiteLLM June 22. Organizations running any of these products should confirm patch status. The OpenAI S-1 is expected to be publicly filed within weeks; it will be the highest-profile technology disclosure since Meta's 2012 prospectus and will establish public valuation benchmarks for AI infrastructure. The Keiko Fujimori formal certification in Peru and South Korea's legislative response to the election warning complete the political calendar. The Philippines earthquake mortality count will clarify over the next 7-10 days as search-and-rescue operations conclude in rural Mindanao.
